inpaintHalo.description: Paint a native background integration layer for the solitude stacks dandelion-resin monument glyph directly into the Mirrored Mile paving beneath it. This is not the foreground glyph itself. Instead, create an opaque environmental halo that makes the solitude tower feel built into the district art: crystalline reflection pools echoing dandelion wisps, cold silver light split into doubled shadows, pale lavender mist hugging the base, glass-frost paving shards, echo geometry scored into the stone, and faint dried-resin bloom traces that match the whimsical reflective solitude style. Keep the center composition open enough for the foreground tower glyph to sit on top cleanly without doubling the silhouette. Match the Mirrored Mile palette, perspective, texture density, and lighting so it feels painted into the map rather than pasted on. No readable text, no logos, no UI, no stickers, no hard outline.
